'''Pikhrons''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. As Devaron's [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] began to advance on the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit's]] courtyard, Pikhrons came to live in the vicinity, and took refuge in the courtyard from the hunters that stalked them.<ref name="NoP" />
